title: Wall in the stability space of the gluing stability conditions on Hirzebruch surfaces
summary: This paper investigates the wall structure of the space of stability conditions on Hirzebruch surfaces. Using the gluing construction of \cite{CP} and \cite{Uch} with respect to a fixed semiorthogonal decomposition, we focus on two main objectives: observing the intersection of the geometric chamber $U(S) \subset \mathrm{Stab}(Σ_e)$ with the walls of the resulting subspace, and determining the moduli space of $σ$-semistable objects on this subspace.
